title: Summit Club Amenities Card — Shower Suites and Spa Credit
content:
Two amenities of the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships vary by membership: the shower suites at hub clubs, and an annual spa credit usable at Summit Club Reserve locations.

| Membership | Shower suites at hub clubs included | Annual spa credit at Summit Club Reserve locations (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | No | 0 |
| Summit Club Individual | Yes | 0 |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | Yes | 0 |
| Summit Club Executive | Yes | 150 |
| Summit Club Corporate | Yes | 0 |
| Summit Club Lifetime | Yes | 250 |

## Reading the card

- Shower suites at hub clubs are included in every membership except Summit Club Essential.
- A spa credit is part of two memberships only: 150 USD a year on Summit Club Executive and 250 USD a year on Summit Club Lifetime. The other four memberships carry a spa credit of 0 USD.
- The spa credit is an annual amount and is used at Summit Club Reserve locations.
